title: Keller–Kindler–Lifshitz influence bound
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every Boolean function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, its variance under the uniform measure, multiplied by $\log(n)/(100n)$, is at most its maximum coordinate influence.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
